dialogues.speaker: Lyney
dialogues.text: This place is really packed! It'll take a stroke of genius to get an edge over all these people, hmm... Got it. I'll use that technique I showed Lynette last time.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I've got other things to do right now...

dialogues.speaker: Lyney
dialogues.text: You're leaving? Can't I tempt you sit back down and play a while longer? I have a new trick I'd like to show you.

dialogues.speaker: Lyney
dialogues.text: Heh, if you're wondering why I won... It's actually because I can predict what cards you'll have in your hand. Don't believe me? Draw a card — any card — and I'll tell you which one it is.

dialogues.speaker: Lyney
dialogues.text: Oh boy, I fumbled that one... It's hard not to get caught up gazing at your facial expressions when I'm sitting right across the table from you. I lost track, and completely forgot to play my strongest card!

dialogues.speaker: Lyney
dialogues.text: Cards? Hehe, please... a magician's bread and butter!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let me adjust my deck first...

dialogues.speaker: Lyney
dialogues.text: Haha, don't lose heart! How about... I shuffle your deck for next round? I can guarantee a good starting hand.

dialogues.speaker: Lyney
dialogues.text: My hat goes off to you. You're the better player.

dialogues.speaker: Lyney
dialogues.text: Sure! But... I have a special trick up my sleeve. Can you guess what it is?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let me adjust my deck first...

dialogues.speaker: Lyney
dialogues.text: Figured out how I did it? No? Don't worry, I'll explain. First, you have to put this card over here, and then...

dialogues.speaker: Lyney
dialogues.text: You read me like a book. Very impressive! Huh, looks like I'll need to work on some new techniques...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I've got other things to do right now...
